# ANEXT - Engineering Solutions

> Connecting the Infinite. Robust, performant, and reliable engineering capabilities built for modern distributed systems.

## Canonical Routes
- [Home Page](https://anext.dev/): Overview of ANEXT capabilities, specialization areas, workflow process, tech stack, and customer verification.

## Core Specializations
- Distributed Systems & High-Throughput APIs (Golang, NestJS, .NET, Laravel)
- Modern Responsive Web Platforms (Astro, Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS)
- Resilient Infrastructure & DevOps (Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Google Cloud, Proxmox, MikroTik)
- High-Performance Database Systems (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, MinIO)
